clock: GPS week 2364 + original text SOW; 10Hz integer-tick output grid
LIO_interpolation: two endpoints only; max endpoint span 0.15s; record availability and delay; no extrapolation or hidden reset
Q_selection: lowest complete natural-route B3 horizontal RMSE; then hold the same Q in B3/B4/B5/B6/P and all ablations
B6_fixed_recovery: same nominal Huber R multiplied by 1+(protection-1)*(1-elapsed/duration)^2; fixed wait before reintegration; no motion evidence; local phased-recovery control, not full Dual-ACKF reproduction
start_rule: first original GNSS at/after offset with complete declared event and recovery coverage; otherwise advance to next valid original GNSS, retain decision
event_window: 10s before fault through 90s after loss/jump/ramp interval; persistent-bias case includes its full 90s hold
primary_metric: paired event macro mean horizontal RMSE versus strongest eligible B4/B5/B6; show each event and each category
normal_cost: unperturbed natural route plus receiver-STD-defined segments, not presumed perfect GNSS
natural_segment_rule: receiver horizontal std norm <=2m and stdD <=4m; labels use input quality, never truth or method errors
baseline_selection: among configs with >=99% coverage and unperturbed natural RMSE no worse than best policy config by max(2%,0.05m), choose lowest primary macro-event RMSE; retain full Pareto table
limits: controlled errors on real F9P; not measured multipath/outages; events on one route are not independent route replications; no paper or novelty guarantee
